# MatterDraft Studio

> MatterDraft is being developed as a local-first desktop workspace for preparing and organising legal documents, from source files to a reviewed, indexed document bundle.

In development for Windows and macOS. Website examples use fictional data and do not establish released functionality. There is no website checkout. Outputs require professional review.
Legal pages are review drafts awaiting completion and adoption, not final published policies.


Local-first does not mean every connected feature works offline. OCR produces editable recognised text; it is not generative legal advice or a guarantee of accuracy.

## Product

- [Product overview](https://matterdraft.legal/index.md): Scope, intended workflows and limitations.
- [Complete content export](https://matterdraft.legal/llms-full.txt): The product overview; draft policies are excluded.
